selection.edition: international Alchemy Ethereum mainnet JSON-RPC and NFT API
selection.ownership: Alchemy Insights, Inc. (Delaware corporation; US HQ in San Francisco / New York). The reviewed edition is the public Ethereum mainnet API at eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Alchemy header-based Authorization Bearer auth (POST https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2 without the key in the path; GET /nft/v3/getNFTsForOwner), create-an-api-key, eth_gasPrice / alchemy_getTokenMetadata / getNFTsForOwner / getNFTMetadata, compute-unit costs (eth_gasPrice 20 CU; alchemy_getTokenMetadata 10 CU; getNFTsForOwner 480 CU), Alchemy Insights Inc US identity, and dated incident search for Alchemy / Alchemy Insights Inc security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Status-page latency events are availability, not customer-data compromise. Distinct Georgia Burn / consulting Alchemy Insights hits were excluded. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Alchemy Ethereum mainnet JSON-RPC and NFT API
research.searchCoverage: Official Bearer Authorization to eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2 and /nft/v3 without the key in the path, Token/NFT methods, CU costs, US operator identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Healthcheck maps to the pinned eth_gasPrice validator (20 CU node ping), not NFT/token search. No qualifying unresolved compromise identified.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Alchemy Insights Inc / alchemy.com security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified status-page latency/outage events only. Distinct Georgia Burn event-ticketing and consulting Alchemy Insights entities were excluded.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to the pinned validator POST JSON-RPC eth_gasPrice on https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2 (20 CU), not NFT/token lookup.
Uses official Authorization: Bearer rather than putting the API key in the URL path.
HTTP 200 JSON-RPC bodies with a non-empty error object are demoted via http.errors.bodyErrorPaths [error].
There is no named get_gas_price upstream action; mapping reuses get_token_metadata as the Token API JSON-RPC sibling. Returns the raw JSON-RPC envelope under data. Upstream user-agent is not sent.
POST JSON-RPC alchemy_getTokenMetadata with params [contractAddress]. Returns the raw JSON-RPC envelope under data instead of the upstream unwrapped {name,symbol,decimals,logo}.
GET /nft/v3/getNFTsForOwner with Bearer auth and no apiKey path segment, matching official header-based docs (reference docs still show /nft/v3/{apiKey}/getNFTsForOwner).
Optional withMetadata, pageKey, and pageSize bind to documented query names. contractAddresses[] array filters and orderBy/tokenUriTimeoutInMs are omitted.
Returns raw NFT JSON under data instead of the upstream {ownedNfts,totalCount,pageKey,validAt} wrapper.
GET /nft/v3/getNFTMetadata with required contractAddress and tokenId query parameters. Optional tokenType is forwarded. tokenUriTimeoutInMs is omitted.
Returns raw NFT JSON under data instead of the upstream {nft} wrapper.
JSON-RPC eth_blockNumber via POST /v2 with Bearer auth.
JSON-RPC eth_getBalance with params [address, latest].
JSON-RPC eth_getTransactionByHash.
JSON-RPC eth_getTransactionReceipt.
JSON-RPC eth_getBlockByNumber with hydrate=false.
JSON-RPC alchemy_getTokenBalances for one address.
JSON-RPC alchemy_getAssetTransfers. category is required; other filters are optional.
GET /nft/v3/getNFTsForContract with Bearer auth.
GET /nft/v3/getContractMetadata.
GET /nft/v3/getNFTSales.
GET /nft/v3/getContractsForOwner.
GET /nft/v3/computeRarity.
GET /nft/v3/isHolderOfContract.
